objective: Convert any off-critical-line zero/count jump into a finite negative certificate and derive a contradiction from an independently proved universal nonnegativity theorem.

witness_interface.index_type: positive natural number or finite encoded test object
witness_interface.finite_certificate: a concrete finite index/object i together with an exact proof that W(i) < 0

preferred_realization.name: Keiper-Li coefficients
preferred_realization.definition: lambda_n = 1/(n-1)! * d^n/ds^n [s^(n-1) log xi(s)] at s=1

secondary_realization.name: Weil explicit-formula positivity
secondary_realization.detector_goal: off-line zero -> exists finitely specified admissible test function f with Q(f) < 0

obligations.statement: Define completed xi and witness W exactly in a valid analytic/formal carrier
Prove every off-line count jump yields an off-line zero quartet in the witness domain
Prove off-line quartet -> exists finite witness i with W(i)<0
Produce an extractable finite certificate format for i and W(i)<0
Construct an independent arithmetic/operator representation of W(i)
Prove W(i)>=0 for every admissible finite witness i without assuming RH or an equivalent statement
Pass independence audit: P1/P2 do not depend on RH, C007, absence of off-line zeros, Li/Weil converse, or a hidden equivalent positivity premise
Combine W3 and P2 to eliminate off-line jumps
Transfer no off-line jumps to exact RiemannHypothesis
Lean verification and clean replay of W1-C2

anti_circularity: Li's criterion may provide W3 and closure, but it cannot itself count as the independent proof of P2.
Numerical positivity for finitely many coefficients cannot establish P2.
A trace/operator formula counts for P1 only after domains, trace class, limits, and equality to W are proved.
The barrier may not assume every zero lies on the critical line, N0(T)=N(T), or any equivalent criterion.
A negative contribution from one off-line zero is not yet a negative total witness; domination of all remaining terms must be proved.
completion_criteria: No finite numerical evidence promoted to universal positivity
